The '''Greejatus family''' was a family that was once very prominent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chommell Minor/Legends|Chommell Minor]]. When their fortunes were lost due to [[Alien/Legends|non-Humans]], a young [[Janus Greejatus/Legends|Janus Greejatus]] was instructed to [[Humanocentrism|look down on aliens]] by his [[Janus Greejatus's father|father]]. The Greejatuses were on friendly terms with [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]] as of [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]].
